messages:
Priya N: Quick check-in after the postmortem — consolidating owners + concrete next steps for streaming timeouts/partials. Keeping this tight so we can ship fixes in the next two sprints.

Marco L: What are the short-term wins vs longer-term work?

Priya N: Short-term (low risk): client-side resume dedupe + backoff tuning, synthetic heartbeat probe. Medium: make eviction predictable / single-thread flush. Long: batching heuristics and prefix-cache refactor.

Tess W: Based on traces, the silent gaps come when prefix-cache eviction blocks the write loop for ~50-200ms, which piles up under certain scheduling patterns.

Andre P: A note: some clients aggressively reconnect if no bytes for >2500ms. We should align defaults and make resume idempotent so reconnects don't duplicate output.

sre-bot: Incident filed INC-2026-404. Auto-linked runbook: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/stream-timeouts (tags: partials, reconnect)

Priya N: Proposed action list (aiming for minimal impact):
- Heartbeat probe + alert (owner: Tess) -> detect silence_rate by deployment. Alert threshold: 0.4% sustained for 15m.
- SDK resume/dedupe spec (owner: Marco) -> client should accept overlapping tokens up to 2s and drop duplicates; backoff defaults tuned.
- Server atomic eviction flag (owner: Andre) -> introduce kv_eviction_atomic boolean and metrics; short lock around flush path.
- Canary plan & run (owner: Priya) -> staged run with targeted eviction forcing.

Marco L: I'll draft the SDK doc. Proposed client defaults:
```json
{"resumeDedupeWindowMs":2000, "maxReconnects":3, "baseBackoffMs":120, "maxBackoffMs":5000}
```

Tess W: I'll build a heartbeat synthetic that opens a 45s stream and asserts no >2.5s gap. Metric name: telemetry.streaming.heartbeat_silence_pct. Dashboard tile + split by region/model. Target promote to staging by 2026-03-29.

Andre P: I'll add kv_eviction_atomic toggle and emit eviction.lock_time_ms. Plan: PR -> unit tests -> stag canary toggle. PR target 2026-03-25, canary 2026-03-31. PR will be #4602.

Priya N: Canary criteria suggestion: run 2k concurrent streams for 8m, force eviction every 20s, success if heartbeat_silence_pct < 0.25 and client reconnect rate returns to baseline.

Marco L: Agree. Also suggest enabling a "resume-dedupe" opt-in flag in SDK for 1 release before flipping default.

Tess W: Obs will include a small alert that pages SEV-2 if silence_pct > 1% in Hosted production for 5m. For staging threshold lower.

Priya N: Ownership + due dates:
- Tess W 0%: heartbeat synthetic + dashboards + alert 0% due 2026-03-29
- Andre P: kv_eviction_atomic PR + metrics 0% due 2026-03-25
- Marco L: SDK spec + draft PR examples 0% due 2026-03-24
- Priya N: coordinate canary run, collect metrics, publish closure note 0% due 2026-04-02

ops-bot: Follow-up meeting scheduled 2026-04-03 09:00 UTC. Reminder set.

Andre P: Rollback plan: flip kv_eviction_atomic=false if canary shows regression. Also we will be able to toggle client resume-dedupe per release channel.

Marco L: Small ask: can we capture a histogram of silence gaps so SDK heuristics can be tuned per model? Tess, can the synthetic emit gap histogram?

Tess W: Yes, will add a histogram metric streaming.silence_gap_ms_bucketed. Will post dashboard link when promoted to staging.

Priya N: Tracking: I'll add all items to INC-2026-404 and to the streaming reliability board with tags: "postmortem-followup", "remediation". Please update the incident ticket when you open PRs or promote the synthetic.

Marco L: Starting SDK doc now. Will ping with a draft link.

Andre P: PR #4602 created (WIP). Will link in INC-2026-404 when CI passes.

Tess W: Synthetic running in dev, initial histogram shows a small cluster at 60-120ms and a tail to ~3500ms. Promoting to staging after one more run. Dev dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/streaming/heartbeat-dev

Priya N: Great progress. Keep updates short here. I'll run the canary during the maintenance window and report results. If green, plan is to roll to Dedicated first, then Hosted.

Marco L: :thumbsup:

sre-bot: INC-2026-404 updated: Andre P added PR #4602, Tess W added synthetic metric.

Priya N: Thanks team — closing the loop for now. Reopen thread if blockers appear.
